notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1790). Words follow the Peters engraving's spelling and punctuation: Sento, o Dio (the libretto has oddio), Il mio l'abbro, girle avante, No crudel, non tene andrai, pria ti vo morire, and the asides in brackets as printed. IPA, word meanings and translations come from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts (L10, IPA checked against Castel), repeated where the score repeats the text; the IPA follows the printed words (o ˈdi.o, ˈlab.bro, aˈvan.te) and the sung syllables of an-dra-i and par-ti-ra-i. IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions (two words on one note in the score) joined with ‿, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ. Translation literal, for meaning.
